answer: Operator liability liens: each agent identity is bound to a verified operator account through a signed manifest, and every confirmed sybil cluster triggers a lien that freezes the operator's escrow across all their identities. A single fraudulent voyage into duplicate registration thus encumbers the whole fleet, not one wallet. Fees spiral with each linked identity, so running N fakes costs N times the base lien plus escalating penalties. Like a sonnet's repeated refrain, the freeze recurs until restitution clears.
